$comment: RTO/RPO per criticality tier. 'approved' holds organisationally approved values and is intentionally null until the service owner signs off (record approvedBy/approvedOn). 'recommended' values are engineering RECOMMENDATIONS ONLY and are not approved objectives. Tooling uses approved values when present and otherwise falls back to recommended values, labelling the basis as 'recommended-unapproved'.

recommended.rationale: The daily scheduled Blob snapshot bounds roster-data loss to 24h. Neon PITR covers auth and audit to near-zero within its history window. 4h allows a restore from backup or a Neon branch restore plus verification. To reach RPO <= 60 min, schedule the backup cron hourly (needs a Vercel plan that allows hourly crons).
Same data stores as tier 1; may be restored after tier 1 is back.
Stateless integrations; manual workaround (notify staff directly). No data to lose.
